name: Patna
metaTitle: Clinic & Hospital Management Software in Patna | Lucoze
metaDescription: Clinic and hospital software for Patna: Boring Road, Kankarbagh, Bailey Road, Kadam Kuan. Plain-English screens, ABHA number on record, DPDP-compliant, all patient data hosted in India.
lead: Patna is where the whole state comes when a case gets serious. Lucoze keeps registration, records, GST billing, lab and pharmacy on one plain screen — so a patient who travelled 200 km doesn't lose a day to a misplaced file.
intro: As Bihar's medical hub, Patna absorbs patients from every district — which means high OPD volume, a lot of first-time and repeat visits mixed together, and a front desk under constant pressure, working in Hindi. Chambers on Boring Road, nursing homes in Kankarbagh, diagnostic centres along Bailey Road: the common failure is the same, a record that can't be found fast enough. Lucoze is built to keep one record per patient, register quickly, and bill correctly the first time. We're an early-stage product taking design partners in East India, and Patna clinics fit that programme well.
points: Search matches name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile — so a repeat patient from a district town is found by their mobile number even if the name was written differently last time, and isn't registered twice.
Plain words, built for the queue

Lucoze runs in English, in short plain labels, and onboarding trains your desk on your own patients. One screen for registration, records, GST billing, lab and pharmacy — fewer clicks when the corridor is full.
Data in India, yours to take
Records live in Indian data centres, DPDP 2023 compliant, with CSV and PDF export any time. No lock-in — if you leave, your data leaves with you.
ABHA number and scheme paperwork sorted
Record the ABHA number at the first visit and keep GST invoices and Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and state-scheme claim records clean, so referrals and reimbursements aren't held up by missing paper.
localContext: We set up Lucoze for clinics, nursing homes and diagnostic centres across Patna — the doctors' chambers around Boring Road, the dense residential OPD load in Kankarbagh, the clinics and labs along Bailey Road, and the older practices around Kadam Kuan. The desk runs in Hindi, with Bhojpuri and Magahi common in conversation, and many patients are arriving from Gaya, Nalanda, Vaishali and further out. Support is remote-first: video onboarding that trains your desk on your own patients, hands-on migration from your registers or current software, and WhatsApp, phone and email. Our team sits in Konnagar, Hooghly, so on-site setup is reserved for larger hospital deployments rather than every chamber.

faqs.q: Will the front desk manage in Patna?
faqs.a: Yes. The screens are in English, with short plain labels a new receptionist can follow, and onboarding trains your desk on your own patients. Search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile finds the record quickly.

faqs.q: Our patients come from all over Bihar — how do we avoid duplicate records?
faqs.a: That's exactly the case it's built for. Search matches name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile, so asking for the mobile number finds a returning patient even if the name was spelled differently last time, and a referral arriving from a district doesn't become a duplicate record.

faqs.q: How fast can a Patna clinic get started, and do you visit?
faqs.a: There's a 14-day free trial and you can be live in about 14 days. Onboarding and data migration are done remotely over video, with WhatsApp and phone support after — on-site help is reserved for larger hospital rollouts.
